title: Humantay Lake Full-Day Tour
short_description: Discover impressive Humantay Lake on a full-day excursion from Cusco, surrounded by glaciers, Andean scenery and intensely turquoise water.
long_description:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure to Humantay Lake, one of Cusco's most impressive natural treasures.

We depart early from Cusco toward Soraypampa, the starting point of the hike. During the ascent, we will cross spectacular Andean landscapes surrounded by mountains and glaciers.

After approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes of hiking, we reach Humantay Lake, famous for its intensely turquoise water and natural setting.

There will be time to enjoy panoramic views, take photographs and connect with nature before descending and returning to Cusco.

days.title: Day 1: Cusco – Soraypampa – Humantay Lake – Cusco
days.text:
We depart early from Cusco toward Soraypampa, the starting point of our hike.

Along the way, we enjoy impressive Andean scenery and stop for breakfast before beginning the walk.

The ascent to Humantay Lake takes approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes through mountain and glacier landscapes.

At the lake, we admire its intensely turquoise water and unique panoramic views. Our guide will explain the natural surroundings, and there will be free time for photographs and rest.

We then descend to Soraypampa, enjoy a buffet lunch and return to Cusco.
